text:
raj: quick follow-up on hedging RFC: telemetry is double-counting hedged attempts in p95 and token agg. need a short plan.
clare: rough cause?
raj: we emit child spans per hedge and dashboards sum them as separate requests. billing also sees doubled token totals for some traces.
ben: saw 1.8x tokens for rq_abc123 in yesterday's canary.
anna: proposal: short-term mark child spans `role=hedge` and exclude from default token_total. mid-term add `X-Redwood-Logical-Id` header for precise joins. long-term provide `gateway.aggregate` span for product metrics.
mike: header cost? tiny. tracing index cost is the real concern.
raj: agreed. also switch retry_counter to increment on aggregate logical object, keep child `attempt` for debug.
ben: streaming resume change: include `logical_id` in resume tokens. gateway tracks `logical_offset` and rejects resumes with `409 ResumeConflict` when offset < logical_offset.
clare: naming: use `attempt_*` and `hedge_*` metrics to avoid conflating safety retries.
infra-bot: perf-run: +1.8% p99 under hedging load.
raj: canary plan: us-east-1 24h, eu-west-1 next, then global. opening follow-up PR.
clare: I'll review.
anna: thanks, looks good :thumbsup:
